data.name: Last Draft
data.detailed_description:
You have retreated to the isolated Blackwood Manor to overcome a paralyzing writer’s block. But the silence in this house is not empty. As you type, the stories begin to bleed into reality, manifesting the very horrors you are trying to capture on paper.

In Last Draft, you must balance the meticulous work of writing a story with the primal need to survive. It is an observation, typing, and horror game where your progress is also a signal for the unseen. Can you survive the horrors whilst completing your required writer's piece in time?

Key Features

  • Observe: Study the manor for subtle shifts in the placement, position, or even color of items. These shifts are not always dangerous; however, misinterpreting them may cause you to hide unnecessarily and waste precious time. You must learn to distinguish between genuine threats and harmless anomalies.

  • Type to Survive: Master a high-tension, typing-based mechanic where each keystroke counts. While every typed word brings you closer to completion, it also brings anomalies closer. Fumble too much, and making mistakes advances the time you have left, accelerating towards your deadline.

  • Experience The Narrative: Write the story as if it were your own. Fully immerse yourself in the short stories you craft. You will encounter a variety of narrative genres, each providing you a completely different perspective and narrative experience.

  • Dynamic Horror: Experience the sudden and reactive reactions from the anomalies if you decide to ignore them. Your neglect of the them will not go unpunished. Will you hide or sit through and challenge the anomalies to see how they'd react?

data.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 2-core 1.7 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060, Radeon RX 480 XT or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2060, Radeon RX 560 XT or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes psychological horror elements such as disturbing audio, visual effects, and themes of fear, isolation, and paranoia. Some scenes may imply harm or threat, which could be unsettling for sensitive players. The game does not contain explicit gore or sexual content.
